notes.title: Weird Worlds: Return to Infinite Space now available for Linux!
notes.content: We're happy to announce that you will now be able to run Weird Worlds on Steam natively under the Linux operating system! This makes Weird Worlds available on every OS supported by Steam. Many thanks to Matt Keller for creating the Linux port and to Henry Kropf for his help in making it happen!

notes.title: Weird Worlds Returns to Mac OS X!
notes.content:
The long awaited day has finally arrived. Digital Eel is pleased to announce that [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/226120/]Weird Worlds: Return to Infinite Space[/url] is available once again for the Mac. This release brings the Mac version up to date with the PC version, and it runs on OS X 10.9 Mavericks or greater.

In celebration of this special event, Weird Worlds for Mac will be available on Steam at a 50% discount. Now everyone can return to Infinite Space, and we hope to see new explorers as well! Also, three Kawangi honks for Henry Kropf whose effort and TLC made this release possible. Thanks Henry!

Be sure to also check out the upcoming sequel to Weird Worlds, [url=store.steampowered.com/app/269990/]Infinite Space III: Sea of Stars[/url]. Sea of Stars is still in development, but the PC version is available in Early Access.  Read the description and watch the teaser. We think you'll enjoy the new approach we're taking to Infinite Space!

notes.title: About Space Time: Infinite Space 3: Sea of Stars Footage
notes.content:
In the time it’s taken me to write this article, I could have started and finished at least two games of Weird Worlds: Return to Infinite Space. I live with that knowledge hanging over me, and I mentally convert every moment of the day into potential games the shortform galaxy explorer. “I’m going for a game of Infinite Space”, I’ll tell my girlfriend as pop off for a plop. “You’ve had me on hold for a trip to Oberon!”, I once told a confused bank phone operator, who apologised and then put my on hold for a full FTL! I took my mega-Peggle of savings to another bank. The video below is only about an sixteenth of a game of Infinite Space long, showing off the mod tools and a few motes of content. It’s enough for me.

notes.title: Now Available - Weird Worlds: Return to Infinite Space
notes.content:
Weird Worlds: Return to Infinite Space is Now Available on Steam and is 25% off!

Weird Worlds: Return to Infinite Space is a hybrid roguelike game of space exploration, adventure and starship combat set within a peculiar as yet unvisited region of the galaxy known as the Purple Void. Each time you play the game, a new and different "instant space opera" is generated at random; from locations of stars and nebulae to plot-twisting quest events, nothing stays the same.

*Offer ends March 29th at 10AM Pacific Time
